visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young child with dark hair, wearing a white helmet with stickers and a grey fleece jacket over a purple shirt and blue pants, squats in the center of a pet food retail store. On the left, a light-colored Corgi lies under a black chair on the grey tiled floor; on the right, another Corgi sits upright. The background features metal shelving units packed with various colorful bags of pet food and supplies. White Chinese subtitles appear at the bottom center, and a logo is visible at the top center. (2) The child remains in a squatting position, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression while gently resting their hands on the heads of both dogs. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor commercial space. The camera remains static at a low angle, level with the child's height. More subtitles appear as the child seems to be speaking to someone off-camera. (3) The child shifts their attention, turning their head to pet the Corgi on the right more affectionately, stroking its neck and ears. The camera zooms in slightly on the child and the rightmost dog. The dog looks calm and panting slightly. The surrounding environment remains consistent with pet shop items and tiled flooring. Final subtitles appear expressing affection toward the animals before the video ends.
